run_habitat_baselines_training: run a habitat baselines training experiment using hydra config with the PPO pointnav trainer
run_habitat_baselines_evaluation: run a habitat baselines evaluation experiment by setting habitat_baselines.evaluate to True in the config
execute_exp_train: execute a training experiment with a DictConfig by calling execute_exp with run_type set to train
execute_exp_eval: execute an evaluation experiment with a DictConfig by calling execute_exp with run_type set to eval
review_main_entry: review the main entry point that patches config and dispatches to execute_exp based on evaluate flag
